text:
Mia: Heads-up — BeaconCloud wants a combined SKU matrix for API + Optimize + Console for their POC. They want pricing for a 3-month POC with reserved API capacity and full Optimize feature set. Can someone help map SKUs and confirm discount band?
Thomas: I'll own technical POC logistics. What are the target qps and expected tokens/day?
Mia: They asked for 200 rps peak, ~50M tokens/month. POC team = 3 engineers, need private logs + SSO.
Jen: For pricing: are we doing credit-based POC or a short-term commit? Any ARR conversion target?
Mia: They prefer POC credits but will likely convert to a 12mo commit if evaluation metrics look good. Customer asked for ~20-25% off list as a reference.
Jen: Deal Desk note: standard cross-product stacking cap is 30% for mid-market. Anything >25% or deviations to Add-on SKUs needs REX approval. Please confirm proposed final ARR to evaluate concession.
Alex: Finance: if they convert, provide projected ARR and payment term (monthly vs upfront). Margin floor on Optimize is a hard constraint for approvals.
Sam: CS: POC timeline is ~8 weeks (onboard, integrate, evaluate). Recommend offering $2k POC credits + 8 hours SE time to accelerate.
Clara: Security checklist: BeaconCloud requires SOC2 attestation, SAML SSO, and EU data residency option. Route the security questionnaire ASAP: https://redwood.share/sec-forms
Thomas: For infra sizing my recommendation: API reserved tier (2x A100 equiv), Optimize with model-caching, Console premium w/ audit logs. Quick SKU mapping below for quoting: 
```
API_reserved_2x: $0.045/token
Optimize_pro: $1200/month
Console_premium: $600/month
POC_credits: $2000 (one-time)
```
Jen: That helps. I'll start the rate-exception form. Need exact legal entity name and proposed convert terms to seed the request.
Mia: Legal entity: BeaconCloud, Inc. Proposed conversion: 12mo commit => ~$60k ARR if they convert after POC.
Jen: Creating REX now. If we propose 22% off on convert, will finance accept? @Alex
Alex: 22% on that $60k ARR is borderline but ok if payment is upfront or at least 6mo prepay. Require margin-protection clause and a 30-day exit if evaluation fails.
Sam: I'll draft onboarding & POC acceptance criteria (SLA, acceptance tests, success metrics).
Mia: Next steps: @Jen submit REX, @Thomas confirm infra PR and prerequisites, @Clara send sec questionnaire link to the customer, @Sam schedule kickoff. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Rate-exception created: #REX-7283 — https://redwood.prod/rex/7283
Jen: REX submitted with notes and proposed 22% convert concession. Added finance margin comments.
Thomas: Scheduling infra prep 3/2-3/4 and reserving the dev pool.
Mia: Thanks all — I'll sync with BeaconCloud tomorrow and update this thread.
